Public Prosecutor v Tan Example [2024] SGHC 101

HC/MA 15/2024
2024-03-18
General Division of the High Court
See Kee Oon J
Ms Example for the Prosecution
Public Prosecutor; Tan Example
Criminal Procedure and Sentencing
Evidence and Witness Credibility

Facts

1 The accused was arrested after an altercation in a public market.

2 The prosecution relied on CCTV footage, witness statements, and section 304A of the Penal Code.

Reasoning

3 The court applied the framework in Lim Example v Public Prosecutor [2021] SGCA 12.

Decision

4 The appeal is dismissed. The conviction is upheld and the sentence varied.
